# mv: convert pointer method to function
mv T.M F
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func (t *T) M() int { return t.X }

func G() int {
	t := &T{1}
	return t.M()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func (t *T) M() int { return t.X }
+func F(t *T) int { return t.X }

 func G() int {
 	t := &T{1}
-	return t.M()
+	return F(t)
 }
